title: Branches split and die on 010110
notes: This machine accepts the words that contain 11 or 101. Each 1 starts a new guess at q2. A guess dies when the next symbol does not fit: q2 has no move on 1, and q3 has no move on 0. One guess survives to q4, and q4 keeps it alive to the end.
ops: start q1; accept q4; q1 0,1 -> q1; q1 1 -> q2; q2 0,eps -> q3; q3 1 -> q4; q4 0,1 -> q4
